messages:
alex_kim: FYI — last-minute change from an analyst on the 4/15 briefing. They just asked to move embargo + asked us to remove a line in the quote. Can we triage?

sam_pr: ugh ok. who is the analyst?

alex_kim: @sam_pr it's Priya from DataSignals. She said she can keep the briefing but needs embargo pushed by 3 hours and wants the quote's competitive claim cleaned up. She DM'd a redline.

maria_product: can we see the redline? link: https://docs.redwood.ai/briefings/priya-redline (internal)

alex_kim: pasted below (Priya's ask):
```
Please remove: "costs 2x less than incumbent" — we don't have apples-to-apples public benchmark.
Also shift embargo to 2026-04-15 12:00 PT (was 09:00 PT). Will confirm final slot by EOD.
```

jordan_legal: +1 to removing the comparative. Also need to drop the line about "enterprise SLA" if we don't state terms. I'll propose safe copy.

sam_pr: thanks. can we get an approved one-liner quote for the launch kit that doesn't make comparative claims? Need this for the press release and the briefing packet.

maria_product: suggested quote options (pick one):
- "Redwood Inference delivers predictable, low-latency LLM serving across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments."
- "Our platform helps teams reduce inference cost while maintaining production-grade latency and reliability."
- "Redwood Inference provides a unified runtime for reliable LLM inference across cloud and private deployments."

olivia_ops: also — if embargo shifts to 12:00 PT, we need to update the webinar follow-up email/send window. That changes the scheduled demo recording at 14:00 PT. Ops can shift recording to 15:30 PT if needed.

alex_kim: @jordan_legal can you paste edited safe quote? Need sign-off in the next 40m.

jordan_legal: here: "Redwood Inference enables engineering teams to run production LLMs with predictable performance and strong operational controls." Good to go from legal on that phrasing.

sam_pr: that works. I'll slot that as the official quote. Can marketing ops update the press kit and the preview email?

olivia_ops: on it. I'll update the embargo meta in the media list and notify the mailing tool. Also toggling the region routing so APAC teams don't get the email at weird hours.

pressbot: [auto] Calendar invite updated: Analyst briefing with Priya (DataSignals) — new proposed time 2026-04-15 12:00 PT. Attendees: alex_kim, sam_pr, maria_product, olivia_ops.

alex_kim: Priya just replied — she can do 12:30 PT instead of 12:00. Can we accept 12:30 but keep embargo at 12:00? She wants embargo to be 12:00 local PT even if briefing runs past it.

sam_pr: we typically ask embargo to hold until the end of briefing, but ok as long as the press kit goes live at 12:00 PT and we alert any reporters on the call. Ops, confirm publish schedule.

olivia_ops: confirm: press kit set to publish at 12:00 PT on April 15. We'll set the CDN cache purge + webhook to newsroom at that time. If the briefing runs late, we'll mute the recording until 12:30 if we need to.

maria_product: heads-up for the briefing: Priya requested a short benchmark highlight on latency/throughput vs sequence length and a note on our caching/batching features in Redwood Optimize. I'll prepare a 2-slide section.

jordan_legal: one more legal flag — we need to add a parenthetical about benchmark conditions: hardware, sequence lengths, and quantization modes. Can you add a footnote slide?

maria_product: will do. Draft slide text: "Benchmark measured on Dedicated GPUs, sequence length distribution representative of production chat workloads; results vary with quantization/profile settings."

alex_kim: PR action items checklist:
- update press quote to Jordan's line (sam)
- update press kit embargo to 2026-04-15 12:00 PT (olivia)
- finalize calendar time with Priya 12:30 PT (alex/olivia)
- add benchmark footnote to slides (maria)
- legal sign-off on the slide copy (jordan)
- schedule newsroom publish + CDN purge (olivia)

sam_pr: I'll draft the brief email to the analyst pool with the approved quote and updated embargo/time and share for a quick look.

alex_kim: Priya just sent one more note: "Can we get a one-paragraph FAQ focused on data privacy and on-prem options?" She said this is important for her enterprise readers.

maria_product: quick FAQ draft: "Redwood Private offers VPC and on-prem deployment options with customer-managed networking and KMS/HSM integrations. Logs and data are isolated per deployment; retention controls and audit logs available."

jordan_legal: tweak: replace "logs and data are isolated" with "customers can configure data isolation and retention controls" — avoids implying defaults.

maria_product: updated FAQ text and put in the shared doc. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/briefings/faq-priya (internal)

sam_pr: great. I'm going to send the updated briefing invite + embargo note to Priya and the analyst list now. Will post a short update here when sent.

alex_kim: thanks team. Quick note — flagging for future postmortem: try to lock embargo + quote at least 48h prior to briefing to avoid these last-minute redlines.

sam_pr: agreed. posting now. :rocket:
